title: TAKE A NUMBER
note: All project hardware is an editorial illustration of a proposal, not built infrastructure.

lines.text: Someone asked to take a number for Cook Inlet.
lines.t: Someone asked to take a number for Cook Inlet.

lines.text: A Needham, Massachusetts company asked federal regulators, FERC, to study an underwater data center.
lines.t: A Needham, Massachusetts company asked federal regulators, FERC, to study an underwater data center.

lines.text: The plan calls for sixty-six seabed pods and about three hundred thirty to three hundred fifty tidal turbines.
lines.t: The plan calls for sixty-six seabed pods and about three hundred thirty to three hundred fifty tidal turbines.

lines.text: About a hundred megawatts, mostly for the data center, and a proposed three and a half mile cable to Nikiski.
lines.t: About a hundred megawatts, mostly for the data center, and a proposed three and a half mile cable to Nikiski.

lines.text: A preliminary permit only lets the holder study the site and claim first place in line to apply for a license.
lines.t: A preliminary permit only lets the holder study the site and claim first place in line to apply for a license.

lines.text: As the company put it, a preliminary permit doesn't give us permission to build anything.
lines.t: As the company put it, a preliminary permit doesn't give us permission to build anything.

lines.text: The formal deadline for objections was five p.m. Eastern on November second.
lines.t: The formal deadline for objections was five p.m. Eastern on November second.

lines.text: Kenai Peninsula Borough Mayor Peter Micciche called the company's approach sloppy. He said he hadn't had an email, letter or call from it.
lines.t: Kenai Peninsula Borough Mayor Peter Micciche called the company's approach sloppy. He said he hadn't had an email, letter or call from it.

lines.text: The company said it was too early to reach out, before the engineering and biology work was done on paper.
lines.t: The company said it was too early to reach out, before the engineering and biology work was done on paper.

lines.text: A commercial fisheries alliance says the proposal didn't assess effects on more than thirteen hundred active permits, and the Center for Biological Diversity filed to intervene.
lines.t: A commercial fisheries alliance says the proposal didn't assess effects on more than thirteen hundred active permits, and the Center for Biological Diversity filed to intervene.

lines.text: In fairness to the company, a study is how anyone gets answers, and this permit wouldn't allow construction.
lines.t: In fairness to the company, a study is how anyone gets answers, and this permit wouldn't allow construction.

lines.text: Cook Inlet belugas have been listed as endangered since two thousand eight. NOAA's best estimate is three hundred thirty-one whales, down from about thirteen hundred in nineteen seventy-nine.
lines.t: Cook Inlet belugas have been listed as endangered since two thousand eight. NOAA's best estimate is three hundred thirty-one whales, down from about thirteen hundred in nineteen seventy-nine.

lines.text: With a population that small, the question isn't whether to study. It's who's in the room when the study is designed.
lines.t: With a population that small, the question isn't whether to study. It's who's in the room when the study is designed.

lines.text: FERC hasn't ruled yet, so should the borough, the fleet and NOAA's beluga scientists help write the study terms?
lines.t: FERC hasn't ruled yet, so should the borough, the fleet and NOAA's beluga scientists help write the study terms?
